source.updateMetadataCaution: API updated literal is 2018-05-14 although returned dimensions include 2026 and webpage says 13 May 2026. Preserve both; do not treat API literal as the observation year.

method: Matched entities by county/municipality/settlement names and table dimension labels before comparing values.
Selected each record's stated year, not the newest year. Years span 2023, 2024 and 2026.
Explicitly distinguished city settlement units from larger city municipalities in 11 capital records.

County aliases are counted as record instances, not additional independent geographic entities. Municipality name/type lookup used local pycountry; this does not certify the historical/current validity of ISO codes.
recommendations: Store full reference date, source table/version and geographic unit type with each population.
Preserve capital settlement-unit scope; for example Tartu 97,759 is the settlement in 2024, while the larger city municipality has 101,032.
Do not interpret correct historical-year data as current 2026 data; any refresh should preserve source vintage and definition.
A county share of the national population must use the same year and compatible coverage; live national denominators are not validated by these exact numerator matches.
limits: No new population value error found in these 67 records.
This comparison does not independently verify every capital's administrative status, borders or general subdivision ISO metadata.
The all-country population dataset and rendered live denominator calculations remain outside this bounded comparison.
